export_mjcf_model_with_assets: export a MuJoCo MJCF model to XML format with all assets saved to a directory
export_model_to_custom_xml: export an mjcf.RootElement to a custom named XML file in the specified output directory
export_model_with_precision: export an MJCF model to XML with configurable floating point precision and zero threshold
save_mjcf_and_assets: save an MJCF model and all its associated assets as files in a target directory
validate_xml_export: validate that an MJCF model export filename ends with .xml before writing to disk
